description: Call this tool for the latest ECB daily reference rates against any base: 1.0812 for USD means 1 base = 1.0812 USD. Crosses go through the euro. Returns the ECB rate date and the cache age.

base.description: Base currency; defaults to the shared business profile's default_currency, else EUR. A rate of 1.0812 for USD means 1 base = 1.0812 USD. Cross rates go through the euro, the only pair the ECB publishes

quotes.description: Only these currencies, at most 200. Omit for all of them

name: rates_latest
title: Latest ECB reference rates
